title: Iran's IRGC says 3 tankers hit mines in Hormuz
gist: Al-Monitor's Middle East Minute podcast episode headlined by Iran's IRGC saying three tankers hit mines in Hormuz, also covering Israel's post-election deadlock and Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi's landmark visit to Syria. Only the episode description is available.
